robot: ALOHA 2 bimanual robot (two ViperX 300s arms facing each other across a table, MuJoCo Playground scene): joint targets only

frame.base_text: the scene's world frame (z up), not either arm's base: no part here takes an end-effector pose

left.note: waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm_roll, wrist_angle, wrist_rotate (rad); gripper finger target 0.037 m open .. 0.002 m closed

right.note: waist, shoulder, elbow, forearm_roll, wrist_angle, wrist_rotate (rad); gripper finger target 0.037 m open .. 0.002 m closed

notes: The arms take joint positions only: there is no end-effector pose command and no kinematics service here, so reaching a point means choosing joint angles (each joint's limits are in describe_robot). The state's gripper value comes from the finger's measured opening, so it stops short of 1 when the fingers close on an object. The two wrist cameras move with the arms; the overhead and teleoperator cameras are fixed. One episode, no reset: the state at the end of your time is graded, so finish in the pose you want graded and keep it.
